info.name: Amazon Dynamodb Create or Replace an Item

items.docs: Creates a new item, or replaces an old item with a new item. If an item that has the same primary key as the new item already exists in the specified table, the new item completely replaces the existing item. You can perform a conditional put operation by specifying a condition expression.

info.name: Amazon Dynamodb Get an Item by Primary Key

items.docs: Returns a set of attributes for the item with the given primary key. If there is no matching item, GetItem does not return any data and there will be no Item element in the response. GetItem provides an eventually consistent read by default. You can optionally request a strongly consistent read instead.

Edits an existing item's attributes, or adds a new item to the table if it does not already exist. You can put, delete, or add attribute values. You can also perform a conditional update by specifying an expected attribute value. You can use update expressions to update attributes.
Deletes a single item in a table by primary key. You can perform a conditional delete operation that deletes the item if it exists, or if it has an expected attribute value.
